title: Endings
summary: The story has five endings. Your choices, and your colonists, decide which you reach.
text:
The story doesn't end the same way every time. There are **five endings**, and the title screen counts the ones you've reached.

Which one you reach isn't picked in one moment. It grows out of the whole campaign: the choices on the story cards, how you treat the planet and the people you meet, and above all what your own colonists think of you by then.

A colony that trusts you, one that doesn't, one that would follow you anywhere: each takes the story somewhere different. There's no wrong way to play, but there are ways to lose everything.
